summary: Longeveron Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting topline results from its Phase 2b ELPIS II trial of laromestrocel in 40 infants with hypoplastic left heart syndrome. The trial missed its primary endpoint, with a least-squares mean difference in right ventricular ejection fraction at 12 months of 0.7 percentage points (95% CI -7.3 to 5.9; p=0.8336). The press release states the Company is exploring all options to maximize shareholder value and will analyze exploratory endpoints and discuss a potential path forward with the FDA. No special-situation transaction terms were disclosed.
